_about: W. M. Lindsay (Wallace Martin Lindsay, 1858-1937), Professor of Humanity at St Andrews, Latin philologist and palaeographer. Classical scholarship (lane B), his English-language studies. Raw IA OCR (mostly Toronto scans): The Latin Language (Oxford, 1894), A Short Historical Latin Grammar (1895, and the 2nd edition of 1915, kept apart because it was rewritten), An Introduction to Latin Textual Emendation (1896), Handbook of Latin Inscriptions (1897), Nonius Marcellus' Dictionary of Republican Latin (1901), The Ancient Editions of Plautus (1904), Syntax of Plautus (1907), Contractions in Early Latin Minuscule MSS. (1908), Notae Latinae (1915) and Early Latin Verse (1922). Not taken: his Latin text editions (Isidore, Plautus, Martial, Terence), and the collation volumes The Codex Turnebi of Plautus (1898), The Ancient Editions of Martial (1903) and Ancient Lore in Medieval Latin Glossaries (1921), which are mostly Latin apparatus; wishlist if Adam wants them. Not A. D. Lindsay (philosopher, a-d-lindsay). US public domain. No uids minted.
